concepts.def: World Bank categories: High-Income Country (UK, US), Newly Emerging Economy (India, Brazil), Low-Income Country (Mali, DRC).
Human Development Index by UN: composite of life expectancy, education and GNI per capita; Norway 0.961, Niger 0.400.
1960 economic development model: traditional, preconditions, take-off, drive to maturity, mass consumption.
Top-down = large government projects (dams); bottom-up = small community schemes (e.g. WaterAid wells); latter more sustainable.
Five-stage model of birth/death rate as country develops; UK at Stage 4, Niger Stage 2, Japan Stage 5 (declining).
NEE with 1.4 billion people; IT sector (Bangalore), TNCs like Tata; persistent inequality and rural poverty.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Global Development — a core area of GCSE Geography.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Global Development brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Global Development.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Why is the Brandt Line considered outdated?
options: Drawn in 1980, it predates the rise of NICs (China, India, Brazil) and globalisation — countries like South Korea, Singapore and Chile no longer fit neatly on the 'poor south' side.
The Brandt Line is the boundary between the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.
The Brandt Line still accurately divides rich and poor countries today.
Because HDI is easier to calculate than GNI.

mcqs.q: Why is HDI a better measure of development than GNI per capita?
options: Because HDI measures how happy people are.
Because HDI is easier to calculate than GNI.
The Brandt Line is the boundary between the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.
HDI combines income, life expectancy and education, capturing quality of life — GNI per capita is just average income and hides inequality and non-economic wellbeing.
Sustainable development means using only solar power.
Sustainable development means stopping all economic growth.
Development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs — balancing economic, social and environmental goals.
Because HDI is easier to calculate than GNI.
